entries.claim: The page prints the twenty words of Gloria Patri and Sicut erat consecutively, through Amen, supplying the wording of w026–w045 expanded from the Trinity proper’s Gloria Patri cue. Its S./M. framing is not evidence for the Trinity Introit’s performer.

entries.claim: Page 366 prints the fourteen-word antiphon and eleven-word psalm verse, followed by Gloria Patri and Benedicta cues. The selected reading expands the twenty-word doxology and repeats the antiphon. Page 401 attests the doxology in two halves separated by an Et laudabili refrain, not as one uninterrupted Introit formula.
